name: time-picker
title: Time Picker
description: Time selection list with configurable steps and unavailable slots.

files.content:
@aware([
    'placeholder' => null,
    'invalid' => false,
    'disabled' => false,
    'clearable' => false,
    'size' => null,
])

<x-ui::input {{
    $attributes->merge([
        'type' => 'text',
        'placeholder' => $placeholder,
        'invalid' => $invalid,
        'disabled' => $disabled,
        'size' => $size,
        'readonly' => true,
        'data-time-picker-trigger' => true,
        'data-time-picker-input' => true,
    ])
}} />
